assumption_falsification_summary.assumption: M7B proves real firmware telephony-ready acceptance
assumption_falsification_summary.risk: Parser-level frame evidence can pass while the firmware remains in a not-ready state.

assumption_falsification_summary.assumption: OOS selector traces are direct firmware selector proof
assumption_falsification_summary.risk: The current selector label is derived from sampled VFD text and must be treated as a heuristic.
Checksum-valid status may still encode an unhealthy or incomplete board bundle.
Clear/status may be arriving after the initialization state machine has already taken the fault path.

selected_hypothesis.description: M7B currently proves modeled frame delivery/checksum, not that the firmware accepted telephony ready during its initialization window.
selected_hypothesis.experiment: Make prompt telephony response the default policy and remove accumulated refresh-byte pulses from the ready path.

prompt_default_policy.evidence: Clear/status still occurred after the not-responding display path and did not produce a replacement VFD payload.

post_config_initial_status_bundle.evidence: The completed configuration download is the earlier response window; however, a pre-latch error-report clear caused a false M7C candidate and final VFD still returned to not-responding.

post_config_initial_status_only.evidence: A prompt status frame after configuration ACK did not prevent or later clear the not-responding display in 45s or 120s captures.

m7c_gate_tightening.evidence: M7C now requires the not-responding banner to have been observed before a later exit can count.

latest_result.next_highest_leverage_condition: status payload semantics or missing board-bundle health field after a valid transport-level C0/C4 exchange
